column3: NKJV includes “in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one,” following the Textus Receptus (the Johannine Comma); the critical text and nearly all Greek manuscripts lack it.
NKJV includes “there are three that bear witness on earth,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.

NKJV has the longer form with “and that you may continue to believe,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to you who believe in the name … that you may know that you have eternal life.”
